sharedFrameContract.pivotCaveat: Target pivot is not an approved per-pose body-root measurement; measure the anatomy and support plane, never center from tail/weapon bounds.
sharedFrameContract.alpha: True RGBA if available; otherwise proved flat external magenta for existing technical extraction. Opaque checkerboards are not transparency.
sharedFrameContract.identity: One locked individual across clips, complete limbs/tail/weapon, no cell crossings, no duplicated/interpolated poses, no recolor of a different profile presented as new drawing.
sharedFrameContract.acceptance: Actual prompt provenance, eight distinct ordered poses per clip, identity/anatomy/direction, measured scale and body roots, clip semantics/continuity, alpha/cell bounds, runtime behavior. File presence alone never promotes.

enemy-019-red-xenomorph.designLock: Aliens Genocide Red Xenomorph Warrior, red caste rather than a Red King or Fireteam Prowler. Visually inspected comic artwork: vermilion/rust-red chitin with deep black biomechanical recesses, long ridged eyeless skull, ribbed slender torso, two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, multiple four dorsal tubes, full long articulated spear tail. Preserve Warrior anatomy and red/black balance; no Queen crown, no quadrupedal Prowler, no equipment or yellow acid sacs. Right-facing orthographic adaptation; do not copy the comic battle composition or green rival subjects.

enemy-020-k-series-yellow-xenomorph.designLock: K-Series common adult Warrior from AVP: Extinction (2003), based on visually inspected game cinematic still: ochre/golden yellow organic exoskeleton with muted pale cream-gray highlights and deep dark olive recesses; elongated eyeless ridged cranial shell with raised central ridge and exposed rib lines; long narrow rib cage and slim waist, two lean clawed arms, two strong digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes, long segmented blade-tipped tail. Select the normal warrior at FRONT LEFT of the reference, NOT the Queen behind it and NOT the black foreground alien. No metallic robotic gear or silver armor; no crown, tusks, cysts or new markings. Common warrior proportions inferred from visible game anatomy for side-view adaptation; not a certified one-to-one reproduction of the original mesh.

enemy-042-combat-synthetic.designLock: Combat Synthetic is an original Aliens: Tantalus Frontier PROJECT_ADAPTATION, not a published model name and not a canon-exact reconstruction. Official and licensed sources establish only the wider archetype: hostile Weyland-Yutani synthetic foes exist, synthetic special-operations units exist, synthetic models serve different roles, and a damaged android may bleed white rather than red. Preserve the project-owned V47.1 identity: one human-scale armored biped with exactly two arms and two legs; a compact armored head with one small cold-white optic; dark charcoal and gunmetal segmented ceramic plates; restrained exposed mechanical joints; and one wholly original compact carbine with a short blunt barrel, rectangular receiver, fixed shoulder stock and detachable straight box magazine. The same individual, plate geometry, optic, joints, carbine and magazine design persist across every clip. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Idle and move use a stable two-hand ready carry; attack is shoulder, aim, fire, recoil and recovery; reload visibly removes the old magazine, retrieves and seats one replacement, operates the action and returns to ready; death is an irreversible supported collapse with the weapon retained in the composition and optional restrained white synthetic fluid, never red blood. No Working Joe skin or work uniform, human Marine face, giant mecha, powered exoskeleton, superhero armor, official logo, iconic pulse-rifle copy, weapon redesign, extra limb, disappearing weapon, left-facing pose, copied official bitmap or 1:1 claim.

enemy-071-albino-red-xenomorph.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed V66 enemy-019-red-xenomorph identity only. Preserve one adult rival-hive Red-caste Warrior: long ridged eyeless dome, double jaw, narrow ribbed torso, lean waist, exactly two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one complete segmented spear-tipped tail. Red denotes the Genocide hive lineage, not a required red coat: albino changes pigment and material response only to warm pearl-ivory and pale bone carapace, cool ash-gray biomechanical recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe soft tissue, dark desaturated cavities, wet highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth; no saturated vermilion shell, flat pure white, glow or automatic recolor. Keep strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile, invariant dome/ribcage/pelvis proportions and the queue's biped motions. Do not inherit numeric sourceScaleByClip values, the historical final-pack scale or legacy bounds-center-bottom roots: the base has no completed measured scaleCalibrationReview, no retained scaleCalibrationEvidence and no reviewed anchor-registry entry. Do not reproduce the base move sheet's cross-cell boundary contacts or its weak locomotion/attack weight transfer. No Queen crown, Red King bulk, Prowler quadruped, yellow K-Series coat, equipment, extra limb or copied comic composition. Every future pixel must be original fan-made/project art; canonExact=false and no 1:1 claim.

enemy-072-albino-k-series-yellow-xenomor.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed V66 enemy-020-k-series-yellow-xenomorph identity only. Preserve one normal adult K-Series common Warrior from the licensed AVP: Extinction lineage: elongated eyeless ridged cranial shell with a raised central keel, exposed cranial rib lines, long narrow rib cage and slim waist, exactly two lean clawed arms, two strong digitigrade legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one long segmented tail ending in a broad hooked blade. Select the front-left common Warrior anatomy in the retained game still, never the Queen behind it or the black foreground alien. Yellow denotes the base faction/material lineage, not a required saturated coat: albino changes pigment and material response only to warm pearl-ivory, pale parchment-bone and low-chroma straw highlights, cool gray-olive recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe tissue, dark desaturated cavities, wet highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth; never flat pure white, bright yellow, glow or automatic recolor. Keep strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile, invariant shell/ribcage/pelvis proportions and the queue's biped motions. Do not inherit numeric sourceScaleByClip values, the historical final-pack scale or legacy bounds-center-bottom roots: the base has no completed measured scaleCalibrationReview, no retained scaleCalibrationEvidence and no reviewed anchor-registry entry. Do not reproduce the base attack's paired cross-cell contacts or documented residual fuchsia artifacts. No Queen crown, black foreground-warrior palette, Red-caste vermilion, robotic gear, silver armor, tusks, cysts, extra limb or official Albino K-Series claim. Every future pixel must be original fan-made/project art; canonExact=false and no 1:1 claim.
